BrochureContent.Content:
Perched on an elevated site overlooking the magnificent waters of Cork Harbour, The Willows is a truly exceptional property offering privacy, space, and breathtaking panoramic views. Set on approximately 0.42 acres of beautifully landscaped gardens, this charming home presents a rare opportunity to acquire one of Cobh's most distinctive residential properties.

Built in the late 1960s, the property extends to approximately 102 sq.m. and offers well-proportioned accommodation throughout. The three-bedroom bungalow has been lovingly maintained and provides the perfect balance of comfortable living and exciting future potential.

The mature gardens create a peaceful setting, while the sweeping driveway and generous parking lead to a detached garage, offering excellent potential for conversion or extension (subject to the necessary planning permission). Whether you're seeking a tranquil home to enjoy immediately, planning to extend for a growing family, or looking to create your forever home, The Willows provides endless possibilities.

Property Features
Three-bedroom detached bungalow
Approximately 102 sq.m. of accommodation
Set on 0.42 acres of mature, landscaped gardens
Spectacular, uninterrupted views across Cork Harbour
Detached garage with excellent extension or conversion potential (subject to planning permission)
Sweeping driveway with ample private parking
Spacious rear garden enjoying a sunny, elevated position
